full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D067 from all four historical reference views.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRICT READING AND MONOLINE REQUIREMENTS:
1. All four references compared. Preserve coherent THX/DYC whole form: high upright main stem with short RIGHT/upward curved hook, broad attached horizontal crossbar, then smooth S-like long descending tail to lower-right.
2. Exactly THREE detached horizontal bars stacked below-left of tail; bottom longest, upper two near equal and shorter. Broad attached upper crossbar is wider than all three small bars. No extra dot, counter, tooth or ritual radical.
3. Critical STYLE correction: use mathematically even monoline tubes, SAME width at every point including bar interiors. Every horizontal has PARALLEL straight top and bottom edges, with a semicircle ONLY at each end. It must NOT be an ellipse, lens, pointed spear, tapered ink or brush silhouette.
4. Every curved main-stem segment and hook has identical nominal thickness to the horizontal bars. Round free ends. Keep the reference's centerline trajectories and gaps, discard its ink-pressure outline variation. Thin nominal width30pixels on1024canvas.
This is a GEOMETRIC STROKE redraw, not calligraphy. Imagine each path stroked once with a uniform circular technical pen. Parallel-sided flat bars with half-circle end caps, no elliptical bars. Keep high upright plus upward-right hook; main crossbar; long right descending S-tail; THREE detached lower-left bars. Black strokes only on transparent.
